description:
Every number on the carrier account behind a trunk that was connected in one step (it has a carrier). attached says whether the carrier already sends its calls here; phone_number_id is set once it is registered. Register one with create_phone_number. A trunk added by hand answers trunk_not_carrier_connected.

Requires scope `phone_numbers:read`.
name: list_carrier_numbers
title: List the numbers on a carrier account
